description: This Java class 'ReadingGoalService' provides service-layer operations for managing 'ReadingGoal' entities, including finding by ID, retrieving all, saving, deleting, and counting goals. It enforces that only one reading goal exists at a time by deleting all before saving a new goal.

classes.name: ReadingGoalService
classes.description: Service class managing ReadingGoal entities, ensuring only one goal exists at a time, with methods for CRUD operations and counting goals.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReadingGoal by its ID, returning an Optional.

methods.name: findAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all ReadingGoals.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new ReadingGoal after deleting any existing goals to maintain a single goal constraint.

methods.name: overwritePreviouslySetGoal
methods.description: Deletes all existing goals and saves the provided goal, ensuring only one goal exists.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all ReadingGoals, effectively resetting the goal state.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of ReadingGoals, typically 0 or 1.
